description_en: Invokes the StartDISyncInstance operation to start real-time synchronization nodes and solution synchronization nodes
description_zh: 调用StartDISyncInstance接口，启动实时同步任务和解决方案同步任务
name: StartDISyncInstance

parameters.help_en: The ID of the DataWorks workspace. You can obtain the ID by calling the ListProjects operation or by logging on to the DataWorks console (https://workbench.data.aliyun.com/console) and navigating to the workspace configuration page. This parameter specifies the DataWorks workspace used for the current API call
parameters.help_zh:
DataWorks工作空间的ID，您可以通过 ListProjects 接口获取，或登录DataWorks控制台 (https://workbench.data.aliyun.com/console)，进入工作空间配置页面获取工作空间ID。
该参数用来确定本次API调用操作使用的DataWorks工作空间
parameters.name: project_id

parameters.help_en:
The type of the data integration synchronization node to start. Valid values:
DI_REALTIME: starts a real-time node.
DI_SOLUTION: starts a solution
parameters.help_zh:
启动数据集成同步任务的任务类型。 目前仅支持使用DI_REALTIME和DI_SOLUTION两种类型：
DI_REALTIME代表启动实时任务。
DI_SOLUTION代表启动解决方案
parameters.name: task_type

parameters.help_en:
If the TaskType parameter settings are DI_REALTIME, FileId is the ID of the real-time synchronization node.
If the TaskType parameter settings are DI_SOLUTION, FileId is the ID of the solution synchronization node
parameters.help_zh:
当TaskType参数配置为DI_REALTIME，则FileId为实时同步任务的任务ID。
当TaskType参数配置为DI_SOLUTION，则FileId为解决方案同步任务的任务ID
parameters.name: file_id

parameters.help_en:
If the TaskType parameter settings are DI_REALTIME, StartParam specifies the startup parameters for the real-time synchronization node, including failover settings, the number of dirty data records, and DDL parameter settings.
If the TaskType parameter settings are DI_SOLUTION, the StartParam parameter is not applicable
parameters.help_zh:
当TaskType参数配置为DI_REALTIME，则StartParam为实时同步任务的启动参数，包括Failover的设置，脏数据条数，以及DDL的参数配置。
当TaskType参数配置为DI_SOLUTION，则StartParam参数无意义
parameters.name: start_param

Data.description_en: The result of starting the synchronization task

Message.description_en:
The description of the cause of the failure to start the data integration synchronization task.

If the data integration synchronization task is started successfully, this parameter is empty
Message.description_zh:
启动数据集成同步任务失败后的原因描述。

如果启动数据集成同步任务成功，则该参数的返回值为空

Status.description_en:
The status of the result for starting the synchronization task. Valid values:
success: The synchronization task was started successfully.
fail: The synchronization task failed to start. You can view the specific cause and handle the related issues
Status.description_zh:
启动同步任务的结果状态。取值如下：
success：同步任务启动成功。
fail：同步任务启动失败。您可以查看具体原因，处理相关问题

RequestId.description_en: The request ID. You can use the ID to locate logs and troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 请求ID。用于定位日志，排查问题

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request was successful. Valid values:
true: The request was successful.
false: The request failed
Success.description_zh:
请求是否成功。取值如下：
true：成功。
false：失败
